papers.title: Transanal tube for the prevention of anastomotic leakage in rectal cancer surgery
papers.journal_full: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
papers.authors: Kawamura H, Tsujimoto Y, Miyakawa T, Hashimoto K, Hirano T, Honda M
papers.abstract:
RATIONALE: Anastomotic leakage is a serious complication of rectal cancer surgery, causing morbidity and increasing healthcare burden. A diverting stoma reduces anastomotic pressure but carries risks. A transanal tube near the anastomosis may reduce spasms and drain stool, potentially lowering leakage risk.
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the benefits and harms of a transanal tube for the prevention of anastomotic leakage in people undergoing rectal surgery, compared with no transanal tube.
SEARCH METHODS: We searched Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), MEDLINE via Ovid, Embase via ProQuest, and four clinical trial registries. The latest search was conducted on 6 August 2025.
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: We included all randomised controlled trials (RCTs) that compared the use of a transanal tube with no intervention in adults undergoing rectal cancer surgery.
OUTCOMES: The critical outcomes were anastomotic leakage, surgical re-intervention due to anastomotic leakage, and any postoperative adverse events other than anastomotic leakage within 30 days postoperatively. Important outcomes included the overall incidence of anastomotic leakage, postoperative length of hospital stay, accidental early removal of the transanal tube, and tube-related complaints.
RISK OF BIAS: We used the Cochrane RoB 2 tool to assess risk of bias in the included RCTs.
SYNTHESIS METHODS: We used random-effects meta-analyses to calculate risk ratios (RR) and mean differences (MD) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). If meta-analysis was not feasible, we summarised the findings narratively. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I² statistic, and substantial heterogeneity (I² > 50%) was explored via prespecified subgroup analysis. The certainty of evidence was evaluated with GRADE. Due to substantial heterogeneity in anastomotic leakage data, possibly influenced by diverting stoma status, we performed prespecified subgroup analyses according to diverting stoma status.
INCLUDED STUDIES: Four RCTs were included, involving 1318 participants: 666 in the transanal tube group and 652 in the no-intervention group.
SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: All included studies were judged to have an overall risk of bias of "some concerns". Overall, the certainty of evidence ranged from very low to low because of the risk of bias, inconsistency, and imprecision. The evidence is very uncertain about the effect of a transanal tube on the risk of anastomotic leakage (RR 0.88, 95% CI 0.46 to 1.72; 4 RCTs, 1318 participants; very low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk of anastomotic leakage was 83 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 73 per 1000 (95% CI 38 to 142) in the transanal tube group (NNT = 100). A test for subgroup differences suggested that the effect of a transanal tube differed according to diverting stoma status (P = 0.03). Among people without a diverting stoma, the RR for anastomotic leakage was 0.72 (95% CI 0.36 to 1.43; 3 RCTs, 911 participants). The anticipated absolute risk was 89 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 64 per 1000 (95% CI 32 to 127) in the transanal tube group. Among people with a diverting stoma, the RR was 2.38 (95% CI 1.00 to 5.69; 2 RCTs, 250 participants). The anticipated absolute risk was 52 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 124 per 1000 (95% CI 52 to 297) in the transanal tube group. A transanal tube may reduce the risk of surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage (RR 0.32, 95% CI 0.10 to 1.00; 3 RCTs, 1124 participants; low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk of surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage was 45 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 14 per 1000 (95% CI 4 to 45) in the transanal tube group (NNT = 33). Among people without a diverting stoma, the RR for surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage was 0.25 (95% CI 0.07 to 0.94; 2 RCTs, 806 participants). The evidence is very uncertain about the effect of a transanal tube on the risk of postoperative adverse events other than anastomotic leakage (RR 1.19, 95% CI 0.76 to 1.88; 2 RCTs, 555 participants; very low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk was 174 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 207 per 1000 (95% CI 132 to 327) in the transanal tube group (NNH = 30). Among people without a diverting stoma, the RR for postoperative adverse events other than anastomotic leakage was 1.39 (95% CI 0.94 to 2.04; 1 RCT, 398 participants). The evidence is very uncertain about the effect of a transanal tube on the risk of overall anastomotic leakage (RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.46 to 1.66; 4 RCTs, 1318 participants; very low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk of overall anastomotic leakage was 87 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 76 per 1000 (95% CI 40 to 145) in the transanal tube group (NNT = 91). One RCT involving 398 participants, all without a diverting stoma, found that a transanal tube may reduce postoperative length of hospital stay (MD -3.25 days, 95% CI -4.55 to -1.95; low-certainty evidence). Accidental early transanal tube removal occurred in 2.7% (range 0-8.2%) of participants with a transanal tube. Tube-related complaints were reported in 25.2% of participants (range 1.9-46.4%).
AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: A transanal tube may reduce the risk of surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage. However, its effect on anastomotic leakage remains uncertain. Subgroup analyses suggested that the effect may differ according to diverting stoma status, with more anastomotic leakage observed with a transanal tube among people with a diverting stoma. Future trials should report outcomes separately according to diverting stoma status and standardise transanal tube characteristics.
FUNDING: This Cochrane Review did not receive direct funding from any organisation.
REGISTRATION: The protocol is available at doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD015472.

papers.title_zh: 經肛門管用於預防直腸癌手術後吻合口滲漏
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：吻合口滲漏是直腸癌手術的嚴重併發症，會造成病患罹病率並增加醫療負擔。保護性造口可降低吻合口壓力但本身帶有風險。放置於吻合口附近的經肛門管可能減少痙攣並引流糞便，有潛力降低滲漏風險。
目的：評估經肛門管於接受直腸手術病人中，相較於不使用經肛門管，預防吻合口滲漏的益處與傷害。
搜尋方法：搜尋Cochrane CENTRAL、MEDLINE (Ovid)、Embase (ProQuest)及四個臨床試驗登錄庫，最新搜尋於2025年8月6日完成。
收錄條件：收錄所有比較經肛門管使用與無處置、於成人直腸癌手術中之隨機對照試驗（RCT）。
結果指標：關鍵結果為吻合口滲漏、因吻合口滲漏之手術再介入，以及術後30天內吻合口滲漏以外之任何不良事件。重要結果包括吻合口滲漏整體發生率、術後住院天數、經肛門管意外提早移除、以及管路相關抱怨。
偏誤風險：使用Cochrane RoB 2工具評估納入RCT之偏誤風險。
合成方法：使用隨機效應統合分析計算風險比（RR）及平均差（MD）與95%信賴區間（CI）。若無法進行統合分析則以敘述方式總結。以I²統計量評估異質性，I²>50%視為顯著異質性並進行預先設定之次族群分析。以GRADE評估證據確定性。由於吻合口滲漏資料存在顯著異質性，可能受保護性造口狀態影響，故依保護性造口狀態進行預先設定之次族群分析。
納入研究：共納入4篇RCT，涉及1318名參與者：經肛門管組666人，無處置組652人。
結果合成：所有納入研究整體偏誤風險皆判定為「有些疑慮」。整體證據確定性因偏誤風險、不一致性及不精確性，範圍從極低至低。經肛門管對吻合口滲漏風險的效果證據極不確定（RR 0.88，95% CI 0.46-1.72；4篇RCT，1318名參與者；極低確定性證據）。無處置組預期吻合口滲漏絕對風險為每1000人83例，經肛門管組為每1000人73例（95% CI 38-142）（NNT=100）。次族群差異檢定顯示經肛門管效果依保護性造口狀態而不同（P=0.03）。無保護性造口者中，吻合口滲漏RR為0.72（95% CI 0.36-1.43；3篇RCT，911名參與者），預期絕對風險無處置組89/1000，經肛門管組64/1000（95% CI 32-127）。有保護性造口者中，RR為2.38（95% CI 1.00-5.69；2篇RCT，250名參與者），預期絕對風險無處置組52/1000，經肛門管組124/1000（95% CI 52-297）。經肛門管可能降低因吻合口滲漏而手術再介入的風險（RR 0.32，95% CI 0.10-1.00；3篇RCT，1124名參與者；低確定性證據）。無處置組預期絕對風險45/1000，經肛門管組14/1000（95% CI 4-45）（NNT=33）。無保護性造口者中，因吻合口滲漏手術再介入的RR為0.25（95% CI 0.07-0.94；2篇RCT，806名參與者）。經肛門管對吻合口滲漏以外術後不良事件風險的效果證據極不確定（RR 1.19，95% CI 0.76-1.88；2篇RCT，555名參與者；極低確定性證據）。預期絕對風險無處置組174/1000，經肛門管組207/1000（95% CI 132-327）（NNH=30）。無保護性造口者中，吻合口滲漏以外術後不良事件RR為1.39（95% CI 0.94-2.04；1篇RCT，398名參與者）。經肛門管對整體吻合口滲漏風險的效果證據極不確定（RR 0.87，95% CI 0.46-1.66；4篇RCT，1318名參與者；極低確定性證據）。整體吻合口滲漏預期絕對風險無處置組87/1000，經肛門管組76/1000（95% CI 40-145）（NNT=91）。一篇涉及398名（全數無保護性造口）參與者的RCT發現，經肛門管可能縮短術後住院天數（MD -3.25天，95% CI -4.55至-1.95；低確定性證據）。經肛門管意外提早移除發生率為2.7%（範圍0-8.2%）。管路相關抱怨發生率為25.2%（範圍1.9%-46.4%）。
作者結論：經肛門管可能降低因吻合口滲漏而手術再介入的風險。然而其對吻合口滲漏本身的效果仍不確定。次族群分析顯示效果可能依保護性造口狀態而異，有保護性造口者使用經肛門管觀察到更多吻合口滲漏。未來試驗應依保護性造口狀態分別報告結果，並標準化經肛門管特性。
資助：本Cochrane綜述未接受任何機構之直接資助。
登錄：計畫書可於doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD015472查詢。

papers.title: Patient-initiated follow-up in surgical specialties: meta-analysis and meta-regression
papers.authors: Pitesa R, Moody S, Hill A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Rising outpatient demand has accelerated adoption of patient-initiated follow-up in surgical practice. This review evaluated whether patient-initiated follow-up safely reduces clinic burden while maintaining patient outcomes across specialties.
METHODS: MEDLINE, Embase, and CENTRAL were searched (2014-2025) for studies of patient-initiated follow-up, defined as a model enabling clinically stable patients to self-initiate follow-up when new or concerning symptoms arise, rather than attending prearranged appointments. Primary outcomes included outpatient appointment volume and patient-reported quality of life. Where studies reported single-arm utilization data, a random-effects meta-analysis of proportions was undertaken. Exploratory meta-regression examined pathway-level factors associated with utilization. Randomized clinical trials (RCTs) were assessed using the revised Cochrane risk-of-bias 2 tool, observational cohort studies using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and qualitative studies using the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme checklist.
RESULTS: Of 1776 manuscripts identified, 34 studies across 6 surgical specialties (breast, colorectal, otorhinolaryngology, orthopaedics, plastics, and urology) were included: 4 RCTs, 17 observational cohort studies, 11 qualitative studies, and 2 mixed-methods studies. Observational studies consistently reported reductions in routine outpatient attendance-including a reduction from 45·0% to 6·0% in first specialist appointments in patient-initiated follow-up in colorectal surgery (P < 0·001) and 52·5% of patients with high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma not recontacting the clinic-without evidence of increased adverse outcomes. RCTs demonstrated non-inferior patient-reported quality-of-life outcomes with patient-initiated versus standard follow-up, alongside reductions in physician contact, including a 50% reduction in planned consultations in breast cancer (1·9 versus 3·8 per patient; P < 0·001) and a reduction in specialist contacts from 42·0% to 23·0% in rectal cancer. In a meta-analysis (1806 participants), the pooled patient-initiated follow-up utilization proportion was 0·19 (95% confidence interval 0·09 to 0·36; I2 = 95%), indicating substantial context-dependent variation. In oncological settings-particularly breast, colorectal, melanoma, and head and neck cancer-structured surveillance and rapid-access systems were identified as critical safety adjuncts to implementation.
CONCLUSION: Patient-initiated follow-up can reduce outpatient burden in selected surgical populations without compromising patient-reported outcomes; however, its effects are dependent on the clinical context and pathway design. Risk-stratified and hybrid models may be the most appropriate, particularly in oncology. Further high-quality trials and robust economic evaluations are required to define optimal implementation strategies.
papers.title_zh: 病人自主回診於外科各次專科之應用：統合分析與meta-regression
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：門診需求上升加速了外科實務中病人自主回診模式的採用。本篇綜述評估病人自主回診是否能在維持病人預後的同時，安全地減少各次專科的門診負擔。方法：檢索MEDLINE、Embase與CENTRAL（2014-2025）中關於病人自主回診之研究，定義為讓臨床穩定的病人在出現新症狀或擔憂症狀時自行發起回診，而非依既定排程回診。主要結果包括門診量與病人自評生活品質。若研究報告單臂利用率資料，則進行隨機效應比例統合分析。探索性meta-regression檢視與利用率相關的路徑層級因子。隨機對照試驗以修訂版Cochrane risk-of-bias 2工具評估，觀察性世代研究以Newcastle-Ottawa Scale評估，質性研究以CASP checklist評估。結果：共識別1776篇文獻，納入34篇研究，涵蓋6個外科次專科（乳房、大腸直腸、耳鼻喉、骨科、整形、泌尿）：4篇RCT、17篇觀察性世代研究、11篇質性研究、2篇混合方法研究。觀察性研究一致顯示常規門診回診減少——包括大腸直腸手術中病人自主回診使首次專科回診由45.0%降至6.0%（P<0.001），以及52.5%高風險皮膚鱗狀細胞癌病人未再回診——且無證據顯示不良結果增加。RCT顯示病人自主回診與標準回診相比，病人自評生活品質不劣於對照組，同時醫師接觸減少，包括乳癌病人計畫性回診減少50%（每人1.9次 vs 3.8次；P<0.001），以及直腸癌專科聯繫由42.0%降至23.0%。在一項統合分析（1806名參與者）中，病人自主回診利用率之匯總比例為0.19（95%信賴區間0.09至0.36；I2=95%），顯示因情境而有顯著變異。在腫瘤學情境下——特別是乳癌、大腸直腸癌、黑色素瘤與頭頸癌——結構化監測與快速回診系統被認定為執行時的關鍵安全輔助措施。結論：病人自主回診可在特定外科族群中減少門診負擔，且不影響病人自評結果；然而其效果取決於臨床情境與路徑設計。風險分層與混合模式可能最為適當，尤其在腫瘤學領域。仍需更多高品質試驗與嚴謹的經濟評估，以確立最佳執行策略。
papers.score_reason: 統合34篇跨6專科異質性研究(I2=95%)，多為觀察性/單臂資料，大腸直腸相關數字具參考價值，但證據強度不足以直接改變臨床路徑。

papers.title: Toxicities of Fruquintinib in Gastrointestinal Malignancies: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Jones D, Sangha T, Manjikian A, Ghobrial M, Shawesh Q, Tiwana E
papers.abstract: Backgrounds: Fruquintinib is a selective vascular endothelial growth factor receptor (VEGFR)-1/2/3 inhibitor approved for previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer. As its use expands across gastrointestinal (GI) malignancies and combination regimens, randomized evidence is needed to define the toxicity profile most relevant to clinical monitoring, particularly hypertension, dermatologic toxicity, renal toxicity, bleeding, and thrombotic events. The objective of this study was to synthesize randomized controlled trial evidence to quantify the incidence and relative risk of key toxicities associated with fruquintinib in gastrointestinal malignancies. Methods: MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Cochrane CENTRAL were searched from inception through 1 January 2026 for phase II-III randomized controlled trials of fruquintinib in GI cancers reporting hypertension, proteinuria, hemorrhage, venous thromboembolism (VTE), and hand-foot skin reaction or palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia (HFSR/PPE). Trial-reported CTCAE adverse events were pooled as risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) using Mantel-Haenszel random-effects models. Exploratory subgroup analyses were performed in metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Results: Four randomized trials (n = 1872) were included. Fruquintinib significantly increased grade ≥3 hypertension (RR 9.01, 95% CI 4.67-17.40) and grade ≥3 HFSR/PPE (RR 26.00, 95% CI 6.42-105.29). Any-grade proteinuria was also increased (RR 1.89, 95% CI 1.30-2.74). Grade ≥3 hemorrhage occurred at low absolute rates and was numerically higher with fruquintinib, but the pooled estimate did not reach statistical significance (RR 1.82, 95% CI 0.92-3.61). VTE estimates were imprecise because of sparse events (any-grade VTE: RR 1.23, 95% CI 0.53-2.88; grade ≥3 VTE: RR 1.96, 95% CI 0.52-7.36). Conclusions: In randomized evidence across GI malignancies, the principal safety signals associated with fruquintinib are grade ≥3 hypertension and grade ≥3 HFSR/PPE, together with increased any-grade proteinuria. Grade ≥3 hemorrhage was uncommon and numerically higher, whereas VTE estimates remained imprecise. These findings support early blood pressure optimization, proactive dermatologic management, routine urinalysis monitoring, and individualized assessment of bleeding and thrombotic risk when initiating therapy.

papers.title_zh: Fruquintinib於腸胃道惡性腫瘤中之毒性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：Fruquintinib是一種選擇性血管內皮生長因子受體(VEGFR)-1/2/3抑制劑，已核准用於先前治療過之轉移性大腸直腸癌。隨著其使用範圍擴展至其他腸胃道(GI)惡性腫瘤及合併療法，需要隨機證據來界定與臨床監測最相關之毒性特徵，特別是高血壓、皮膚毒性、腎毒性、出血及血栓栓塞事件。本研究目的為統整隨機對照試驗證據，量化fruquintinib於腸胃道惡性腫瘤中相關主要毒性之發生率與相對風險。方法：檢索MEDLINE、EMBASE及Cochrane CENTRAL資料庫，自建庫起至2026年1月1日，納入報告高血壓、蛋白尿、出血、靜脈血栓栓塞(VTE)及手足皮膚反應/掌蹠紅腫症(HFSR/PPE)之fruquintinib第二至三期隨機對照試驗。使用Mantel-Haenszel隨機效應模型將各試驗報告之CTCAE不良事件彙整為風險比(RR)及95%信賴區間(CI)。並於轉移性大腸直腸癌(mCRC)進行探索性次群組分析。結果：共納入4項隨機試驗(n=1872)。Fruquintinib顯著增加三級以上高血壓(RR 9.01，95% CI 4.67-17.40)及三級以上HFSR/PPE(RR 26.00，95% CI 6.42-105.29)。任何等級蛋白尿亦增加(RR 1.89，95% CI 1.30-2.74)。三級以上出血發生率之絕對數值偏低，fruquintinib組數值上較高，但統合估計未達統計顯著(RR 1.82，95% CI 0.92-3.61)。VTE之估計因事件數稀少而不精確(任何等級VTE：RR 1.23，95% CI 0.53-2.88；三級以上VTE：RR 1.96，95% CI 0.52-7.36)。結論：在跨腸胃道惡性腫瘤之隨機證據中，fruquintinib之主要安全性訊號為三級以上高血壓及三級以上HFSR/PPE，並伴隨任何等級蛋白尿增加。三級以上出血並不常見但數值上較高，而VTE估計仍不精確。這些發現支持於開始治療時及早進行血壓優化、積極皮膚科處置、常規尿液檢查監測，並針對出血與血栓風險進行個別化評估。

papers.title: Methodological challenges in surgical randomized trials: systematic review of rectal cancer studies
papers.authors: Kitaguchi D, Giménez M, Forgione A, Oda T, Marescaux J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Surgical randomized clinical trials (RCTs) have structural features that differ fundamentally from those of non-surgical trials, which may complicate appraisal using standard assessment frameworks. This methodological systematic review used rectal cancer surgery RCTs as a high-complexity exemplar to identify surgically specific methodological challenges and to examine their interaction with established tools for assessing risk of bias and certainty of evidence.
METHODS: A systematic literature search was conducted in PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library on 1 November 2025. Eligible studies were RCTs evaluating surgery-related interventions for rectal cancer in adult patients, published in English from 2020 onward, with sufficient methodological detail. Included trials were categorized into predefined, mutually exclusive surgical RCT types. Methodological features were descriptively summarized and conceptually mapped to the domains of the revised Cochrane Risk of Bias (RoB 2) tool and the GRADE framework using both quantitative tabulation and narrative synthesis.
RESULTS: Of 1529 records identified, 45 publications reporting on 35 RCTs were included. Trials were classified into five surgical RCT categories. Surgically specific methodological challenges were most frequently observed in RoB 2 domains D2 (bias due to deviations from intended interventions) and D4 (bias in measurement of the outcome), as well as in the GRADE domain of indirectness.
CONCLUSION: This review suggests that several challenges encountered when applying RoB 2 and GRADE to surgical RCTs arise from structural characteristics of surgical trial design rather than obvious methodological shortcomings. Contextualizing standard appraisal frameworks within the realities of surgical research may allow for a more nuanced interpretation of existing evidence, inform future trial design, and support more appropriate evidence synthesis.

papers.title_zh: 外科隨機對照試驗的方法學挑戰：直腸癌研究的系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：外科隨機對照試驗（RCT）在結構特徵上與非外科試驗有根本性差異，這可能使標準評估框架的應用變得複雜。本方法學系統性回顧以直腸癌手術RCT作為高複雜度範例，用以辨識外科特有的方法學挑戰，並檢視這些挑戰與現行偏誤風險評估工具及證據確定性評估工具之間的交互作用。方法：於2025年11月1日在PubMed、Embase及Cochrane Library進行系統性文獻搜尋。符合條件之研究為評估成人直腸癌病人手術相關介入之RCT，2020年以後以英文發表，且具備足夠方法學細節者。納入試驗依預先定義、互斥的外科RCT類型分類。方法學特徵以描述性方式總結，並依量化列表與敘事性綜合方式，概念性對應至修訂版Cochrane偏誤風險（RoB 2）工具及GRADE框架之各領域。結果：從1529筆文獻中，最終納入45篇報告，涵蓋35個RCT。試驗被分類為五種外科RCT類型。外科特有的方法學挑戰最常出現在RoB 2的D2領域（因偏離預定介入所致之偏誤）及D4領域（結果測量偏誤），以及GRADE框架中的間接性（indirectness）領域。結論：本回顧顯示，將RoB 2與GRADE應用於外科RCT時遭遇的多項挑戰，源自外科試驗設計的結構性特徵，而非明顯的方法學缺陷。將標準評估框架置於外科研究的實際情境中理解，可能有助於更細緻地詮釋既有證據、指引未來試驗設計，並支持更適切的證據綜合。

papers.title: Upadacitinib treatment in pediatric Crohn's disease: 52-week outcomes of an international multicenter retrospective cohort study from the pediatric IBD Porto Group of ESPGHAN
papers.authors: Spencer E, Cohen S, Dubinsky M, Suskind D, Mitrova K, Hradsky O
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Data on upadacitinib maintenance therapy in pediatric Crohn's disease (CD) are scarce. We aimed to evaluate the effectiveness, safety, and dosing of upadacitinib as maintenance therapy in pediatric CD.
METHODS: Children treated with upadacitinib for maintenance of remission of active CD from 35 centers affiliated with the Porto Group of ESPGHAN were included in this retrospective cohort study. Data on demographic, clinical, laboratory, endoscopic, and imaging findings and on adverse events (AEs) were recorded over 52 weeks of follow-up.
RESULTS: A total of 120 children were included (91 receiving upadacitinib as monotherapy and 29 as combination advanced therapy, mean age 15.4 ± 2.5 years). Prior to upadacitinib induction, 119/120 (99%) children had been treated with biologic therapies, 104 (87%) with two or more biologics and 98 (82%) had failed both vedolizumab and ustekinumab. Clinical remission and corticosteroid-free clinical remission (CFR) were observed after upadacitinib induction in 77 (64%) and 72 (60%) children, respectively. By week 52, 74 (62%) children achieved both clinical remission and CFR, and CFR was sustained in 66 (55%) children. CFR with normal C-reactive protein levels was achieved in 50% of children and CFR with fecal calprotectin levels <150 µg/g was achieved in 33% of children by week 52. Fifty-three (44%) children sustained AEs, two of which were serious (severe acne and intestinal perforation). The most frequent AEs were acne (n = 23), hyperlipidemia (n = 18), and infections (n = 14).
CONCLUSION: Upadacitinib is an effective maintenance therapy for refractory pediatric CD. Effectiveness should be weighed against the potential risks of AEs.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：兒童Crohn氏症（CD）使用upadacitinib維持治療的資料稀少。本研究目的為評估upadacitinib作為兒童CD維持治療的療效、安全性與劑量。方法：本回溯性世代研究納入來自ESPGHAN Porto Group 35個中心，使用upadacitinib維持活動性CD緩解的兒童。追蹤52週，記錄人口學、臨床、實驗室、內視鏡及影像學發現，以及不良事件（AEs）。結果：共納入120名兒童（91名接受upadacitinib單一療法，29名接受合併進階療法，平均年齡15.4±2.5歲）。使用upadacitinib誘導前，119/120（99%）名兒童曾接受生物製劑治療，104名（87%）曾使用兩種或以上生物製劑，98名（82%）曾對vedolizumab與ustekinumab皆治療失敗。upadacitinib誘導後，77名（64%）與72名（60%）兒童分別達到臨床緩解及無類固醇臨床緩解（CFR）。至第52週，74名（62%）兒童同時達到臨床緩解與CFR，66名（55%）兒童維持CFR。至第52週，50%兒童達到C反應蛋白正常之CFR，33%兒童達到糞便鈣蛋白<150 µg/g之CFR。53名（44%）兒童發生不良事件，其中2件為嚴重（嚴重痤瘡及腸穿孔）。最常見的AEs為痤瘡（n=23）、高脂血症（n=18）及感染（n=14）。結論：Upadacitinib對難治性兒童CD是有效的維持治療，療效需與AE潛在風險權衡考量。

papers.title: Effectiveness and safety of tacrolimus versus infliximab as rescue therapy for intravenous corticosteroid-refractory acute severe ulcerative colitis: a multicenter cohort study
papers.authors: Katano T, Okabayashi S, Yamazaki H, Matsubayashi M, Serizawa K, Nakashima M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND & AIMS: Acute severe ulcerative colitis (ASUC) refractory to intravenous corticosteroids (IVCS) is a major clinical challenge with limited rescue therapy options. Although tacrolimus has been proposed as a potential rescue therapy, its effectiveness and safety compared with infliximab, widely used in this setting, remain unclear.
METHODS: A multicenter retrospective cohort study was conducted across 34 Japanese institutions, including hospitalized patients with IVCS-refractory ASUC who received infliximab or tacrolimus as rescue therapy between January 2014 and March 2023. The primary outcome was clinical remission at day 14, using two-item patient-reported outcome scoring. Secondary outcomes included clinical response at day 3 and 7, colectomy, and adverse events within 56 days. A modified Poisson regression model was used for analysis.
RESULTS: Among 300 patients (infliximab, n = 113; tacrolimus, n = 187), clinical remission at day 14 occurred in 41.6% and 33.7%, respectively, with no difference (adjusted risk ratio [RR] 0.87 [95% CI: 0.65, 1.17]). Clinical response at day 3 was lower with tacrolimus (infliximab 42.5% vs tacrolimus 24.1%; adjusted RR 0.58 [95% CI: 0.42, 0.80]) but did not differ at day 7 (infliximab 63.7% vs tacrolimus 51.9%; adjusted RR 0.83 [95% CI: 0.69, 1.01]). No difference in colectomy within 56 days was observed, although rates were higher in the tacrolimus (13.3% vs 20.3%; adjusted RR 1.58 [95% CI: 0.93, 2.67]). Adverse events were similar between groups (infliximab 8.8% vs tacrolimus 7.5%; adjusted RR 0.77 [95% CI: 0.37, 1.57]).
CONCLUSIONS: Tacrolimus demonstrated comparable effectiveness and safety to infliximab as rescue therapy for IVCS-refractory ASUC, although early response was slower.
papers.title_zh: Tacrolimus 與 Infliximab 作為靜脈類固醇難治型急性重症潰瘍性結腸炎(ASUC)之救援治療：多中心世代研究比較其療效與安全性
papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：對靜脈類固醇(IVCS)治療無效的急性重症潰瘍性結腸炎(ASUC)是臨床上的重大挑戰，救援治療選項有限。雖然 tacrolimus 已被提出作為潛在救援治療，但其療效與安全性相較於此情境中廣泛使用的 infliximab，仍不明確。方法：本研究為多中心回溯性世代研究，橫跨34家日本機構，納入2014年1月至2023年3月間因IVCS難治型ASUC住院並接受infliximab或tacrolimus作為救援治療的病人。主要結果為第14天臨床緩解，採用兩項患者報告結果評分系統。次要結果包括第3天與第7天臨床反應、結腸切除術、以及56天內不良事件。分析採用修正式Poisson回歸模型。結果：共300名病人（infliximab組113人；tacrolimus組187人），第14天臨床緩解率分別為41.6%與33.7%，兩組無差異（調整後風險比[RR] 0.87 [95% CI: 0.65, 1.17]）。第3天臨床反應tacrolimus組較低（infliximab 42.5% vs tacrolimus 24.1%；調整後RR 0.58 [95% CI: 0.42, 0.80]），但第7天無差異（infliximab 63.7% vs tacrolimus 51.9%；調整後RR 0.83 [95% CI: 0.69, 1.01]）。56天內結腸切除率無顯著差異，但tacrolimus組比率較高（13.3% vs 20.3%；調整後RR 1.58 [95% CI: 0.93, 2.67]）。兩組不良事件發生率相近（infliximab 8.8% vs tacrolimus 7.5%；調整後RR 0.77 [95% CI: 0.37, 1.57]）。結論：Tacrolimus在IVCS難治型ASUC救援治療中展現與infliximab相當的療效與安全性，惟早期反應較慢。

papers.title: Modified single-stapled anastomosis in laparoscopic or robotic low anterior resection for rectal cancer: protocol for a multicentre randomised controlled trial
papers.authors: Ryu H, Kwak J, Baek S, Min B, Cho M, Yang S
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Anastomotic leakage remains one of the most serious complications after low anterior resection for rectal cancer. The modified single-stapled technique (MST) eliminates the intersection between linear and circular staple lines and may reduce leakage compared with the conventional double-stapled technique (DST). This trial aims to determine whether MST reduces anastomotic leakage in patients undergoing laparoscopic or robotic low anterior resection.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This is a multicentre, parallel-group and superiority randomised controlled trial conducted in six tertiary hospitals in South Korea. A total of 450 patients undergoing laparoscopic or robotic low anterior resection for rectal cancer will be randomised in a 1:1 ratio to MST or DST. Randomisation will be stratified by sex and neoadjuvant treatment. The primary outcome is anastomotic leakage within 30 days after surgery, confirmed by clinical findings and routine postoperative abdominopelvic CT. Secondary outcomes include additional distal resection margin length, local recurrence, 3-year disease-free survival and overall survival. Analyses will follow the intention-to-treat principle.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: The study was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Korea University Anam Hospital (2025AN0114). Results will be disseminated through peer-reviewed journals and scientific meetings.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT07376980.

papers.title: Defining absolute postoperative desmoid risk in familial adenomatous polyposis according to APC genotype and family history: retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Zare B, Bahar M, Clark S, Latchford A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Desmoid disease is a major cause of morbidity and mortality in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), particularly after prophylactic colorectal surgery. Although APC genotype and family history are recognized risk factors, previous sizeable studies report relative rather than absolute risks. This study aimed to quantify absolute postoperative desmoid risk in FAP patients undergoing risk-reducing colectomy, stratified by APC genotype, and to assess the modifying effect of family history.
METHODS: This retrospective observational study used records from a prospectively maintained registry. Patients with an APC pathogenic variant (PV) 3' of codon 1399 were classified as high risk, and those with an APC PV 5' of (or at) codon 1399 were classified as low risk. Patients who had not undergone prophylactic colectomy, with < 5 years of postoperative follow-up, or those with a desmoid diagnosed before or at the time of surgery were excluded. Clinical records were reviewed for details of surgery, desmoid diagnosis, and family history. A positive family history was defined as a first-degree relative with genetically confirmed FAP and a diagnosis of desmoid disease (clinical and/or radiological).
RESULTS: Among 48 high-risk patients, 30 (63%) developed desmoid, with no significant difference between colectomy and proctocolectomy (54% versus 70%, respectively; χ2 = 1.42; P = 0.233). Family history was present in 35 of the 48 patients (73%) and increased desmoid risk relative to no family history (80% versus 15%, respectively; P < 0.01). Among the 1213 low-risk patients, 154 (12.7%) developed desmoids, with no significant effect of surgical procedure (13.9% versus 12.1% for proctocolectomy and total/partial colectomy, respectively; χ² = 0.77; P = 0.380). Family history increased desmoid risk relative to no family history (30% versus 10%, respectively; P < 0.01).
CONCLUSION: A family history of desmoid disease appears to be an important determinant of postoperative desmoid risk in FAP. Although APC PV 3' of codon 1399 does confer a high overall risk, this is largely confined to individuals with first-degree relatives with desmoid. In the absence of a family history, postoperative desmoid risk appeared relatively low regardless of genotype. This supports a more individualized approach to perioperative counselling and surgical decision-making in patients with FAP. In addition, these data highlight that patients with both a 3' APC PV and a positive family history are a particularly high-risk subgroup who may represent an appropriate target population for future chemoprevention trials.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：Desmoid疾病是家族性大腸腺瘤性息肉症（FAP）患者主要的併發症與死亡原因，尤其發生於預防性大腸直腸手術之後。雖然APC基因型與家族史已被認定為風險因子，但既往大型研究多報告相對風險而非絕對風險。本研究目的為量化FAP患者接受降風險結腸切除術後之絕對desmoid風險，依APC基因型分層，並評估家族史之修飾效應。

方法：本回溯性觀察性研究使用前瞻性維護登錄資料庫之紀錄。攜帶codon 1399 3'端APC致病性變異（PV）者分類為高風險，攜帶codon 1399 5'端（或該位置）APC PV者分類為低風險。排除未接受預防性結腸切除、術後追蹤未達5年、或於手術前或手術當下已診斷desmoid之患者。回顧臨床紀錄以取得手術細節、desmoid診斷與家族史。陽性家族史定義為一級親屬經基因確診FAP且被診斷desmoid疾病（臨床及/或影像學）。

結果：48名高風險患者中，30人（63%）發生desmoid，結腸切除術與全結腸直腸切除術之間無顯著差異（分別為54%與70%；χ²=1.42；P=0.233）。48人中35人（73%）有家族史，家族史使desmoid風險相對於無家族史者顯著增加（分別為80%與15%；P<0.01）。1213名低風險患者中，154人（12.7%）發生desmoid，手術方式無顯著影響（全結腸直腸切除術與全/部分結腸切除術分別為13.9%與12.1%；χ²=0.77；P=0.380）。家族史使desmoid風險相對於無家族史者增加（分別為30%與10%；P<0.01）。

結論：desmoid疾病家族史似為FAP術後desmoid風險之重要決定因子。雖然codon 1399 3'端之APC PV確實帶來較高整體風險，但此風險主要集中於有一級親屬罹患desmoid者。在無家族史情況下，無論基因型如何，術後desmoid風險皆相對偏低。此結果支持對FAP患者採取更個人化之圍術期諮詢與手術決策方式。此外，這些數據凸顯同時具有3' APC PV與陽性家族史者為特別高風險亞群，可能是未來化學預防試驗適合的目標人群。

papers.title: Extracellular vesicle-based therapies in IBD: immunomodulation, regeneration, and translation
papers.authors: Lu E, Sun M, Meng H, Zhang M
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is sustained by dysregulated mucosal immune activation, maladaptive immune-cell crosstalk, epithelial barrier failure, and impaired tissue repair. This narrative review critically evaluates unmodified native mammalian EVs, donor-conditioned EVs, milk-derived EVs, post-isolation engineered EV products, and plant-derived EV-like nanoparticles (PELNs) as candidate immunomodulatory and mucosal-repair platforms. The evidence is dominated by chemically induced rodent colitis, particularly acute mucosal injury models; controlled efficacy data in patients with luminal ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease are not available, and the small uncontrolled perianal-fistula study provides only preliminary local safety and feasibility observations. Reported outcomes include changes in inflammatory myeloid states, tolerance-associated dendritic-cell states, Treg/Th17 balance, epithelial protection, barrier restoration, tissue repair, and, for a narrower subset of preparations, stem/progenitor-associated regeneration. Mechanistic intervention studies include dendritic-cell AMPK dependence for broccoli-derived nanoparticles and PD-1/PHB1-related activity for engineered PD-L1/miR-27a-3p EVs, whereas many macrophage, microbiota, barrier, and cargo-delivery claims remain associative or preparation-specific. Engineering may improve exposure, target-cell engagement, cargo control, or receptor signaling, but each proposed advantage requires direct comparison with an appropriate unmodified or clinically relevant comparator and introduces additional manufacturing and safety requirements. We therefore separate product identity, disease-relevant regional or systemic exposure, target-cell engagement, functional intracellular cargo delivery, surface-receptor signaling, pharmacodynamic response, and repair outcomes. Translation will require reproducible dose metrics, mechanism-linked validation, validated lot-release potency assays, chronic repeat-dose safety, and phenotype-relevant human models.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的維持機轉包括黏膜免疫活化失調、免疫細胞間交互作用不良、上皮屏障功能失效及組織修復受損。本敘述性文獻回顧批判性評估未修飾之天然哺乳動物細胞外囊泡（EV）、供體條件化EV、乳汁來源EV、分離後工程化EV產品，以及植物來源EV樣奈米粒子（PELNs）作為候選免疫調節與黏膜修復平台的證據。現有證據主要來自化學誘導之囓齒動物大腸炎模型，特別是急性黏膜損傷模型；在管腔型潰瘍性大腸炎或克隆氏症患者中缺乏對照性療效數據，唯一的小型無對照肛門瘻管研究僅提供初步的局部安全性與可行性觀察。已報告之結果包括發炎性骨髓細胞狀態、耐受性樹突狀細胞狀態、Treg/Th17平衡、上皮保護、屏障修復、組織修復之改變，以及在較窄範圍的製劑中，與幹/前驅細胞相關的再生反應。機轉性介入研究包括花椰菜衍生奈米粒子的樹突狀細胞AMPK依賴性，以及工程化PD-L1/miR-27a-3p EV之PD-1/PHB1相關活性，而許多關於巨噬細胞、微生物群、屏障及貨物遞送的宣稱仍屬相關性或製劑特異性的觀察。工程化可能改善暴露程度、目標細胞接合、貨物控制或受體訊號傳遞，但每項提出的優勢皆需與適當的未修飾或具臨床相關性之對照組直接比較，且會帶來額外的製造與安全性要求。因此我們區分產品身分鑑定、疾病相關之區域性或全身性暴露、目標細胞接合、功能性細胞內貨物遞送、表面受體訊號傳遞、藥效動力學反應與修復結果。臨床轉譯將需要可重現的劑量指標、機轉連結之驗證、經驗證的批次釋放效價檢測、慢性重複劑量安全性，以及具表型相關性的人類模型。

papers.title: ILC plasticity in intestinal immune barrier remodeling: current evidence and therapeutic implications for inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Zhou Z, Ling P, Wang J, Zhang X, Shen Y
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which includes Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), is a group of chronic gastrointestinal inflammatory diseases characterized by persistent mucosal inflammation and intestinal immune barrier dysfunction. Innate lymphoid cells (ILCs) are key regulators of mucosal immunity; however, the contribution of their context-dependent plasticity to IBD-associated immune barrier remodeling remains incompletely defined. This narrative review summarizes the intestinal distribution and functional specialization of ILC subsets, their dysregulation in the IBD microenvironment, and the molecular signals that regulate ILC plasticity. Current evidence most strongly supports an ILC3-to-ILC1 transition in CD, whereas direct evidence for defined directional ILC plasticity in UC and for ILC2 lineage conversion in intestinal IBD remains limited. We also discuss the context-dependent roles of ILC2s in epithelial repair, inflammation, and fibrosis, as well as the functional reprogramming of ILC3s from barrier-protective to potentially pathogenic states. In addition, this review summarizes the cytokine, transcriptional, epigenetic, and metabolic mechanisms associated with ILC fate remodeling and discusses potential therapeutic strategies targeting these pathways. Overall, ILC plasticity may represent a disease- and tissue-specific mechanism contributing to intestinal immune barrier remodeling, although its causal role and therapeutic relevance require further validation in human IBD. These findings provide a framework for developing more precisely stratified and context-dependent therapeutic approaches for IBD.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）包括克隆氏症（CD）與潰瘍性大腸炎（UC），是一組以持續性黏膜發炎與腸道免疫屏障功能障礙為特徵的慢性胃腸道發炎疾病。先天淋巴細胞（ILC）是黏膜免疫的關鍵調控者；然而其依情境而異的可塑性對IBD相關免疫屏障重塑的貢獻仍未完全明確。本敘述性綜述總結了ILC亞群的腸道分布與功能特化、其在IBD微環境中的失調，以及調控ILC可塑性的分子訊號。目前證據最支持CD中存在ILC3向ILC1轉變，而UC中明確方向性ILC可塑性、以及腸道IBD中ILC2譜系轉換的直接證據仍有限。我們也討論了ILC2在上皮修復、發炎與纖維化中依情境而異的角色，以及ILC3從屏障保護性狀態向潛在致病性狀態的功能重編程。此外，本綜述總結了與ILC命運重塑相關的細胞因子、轉錄、表觀遺傳與代謝機轉，並討論針對這些路徑的潛在治療策略。總體而言，ILC可塑性可能代表一種疾病與組織特異性機轉，參與腸道免疫屏障重塑，但其因果角色與治療相關性仍需在人類IBD中進一步驗證。這些發現為開發更精準分層、依情境而異的IBD治療方法提供了框架。

papers.title: Fruquintinib: Mechanism of Action, Clinical, and Translational Science
papers.authors: Zhou X, Dasari A, Li J, Chien C, Dong Q, Chen L
papers.abstract: Fruquintinib is a highly selective, oral inhibitor of all three vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (-1, -2, and -3) that was approved, including in China, the United States, and the European Union, for the treatment of previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). The efficacy of fruquintinib for mCRC has been consistently demonstrated in randomized, double-blind, Phase 3 clinical studies, including FRESCO (NCT02314819), which enrolled patients in China, and FRESCO-2 (NCT04322539), which enrolled patients across 14 countries in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. In both studies, patients were randomized 2:1 to receive oral fruquintinib 5 mg or a matching placebo once daily, 3 weeks on, 1 week off, in 28-day cycles, plus best supportive care, until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Both FRESCO and FRESCO-2 met their primary endpoints, demonstrating significant improvements in overall survival (OS) with fruquintinib versus placebo: in FRESCO (fruquintinib: n = 278; placebo: n = 138), median OS was 9.3 with fruquintinib versus 6.6 months with placebo (hazard ratio [HR], 0.65; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.51-0.83; p < 0.001); in FRESCO-2 (fruquintinib: n = 461; placebo: n = 230), median OS was 7.4 with fruquintinib versus 4.8 months with placebo (HR, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.55-0.80; p < 0.001). The most common any-grade treatment-emergent adverse events with fruquintinib (incidence ≥ 20% in either study, excluding laboratory abnormalities) were hypertension, palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia, proteinuria, dysphonia, diarrhea, asthenia, decreased appetite, hypothyroidism, and fatigue. This mini-review summarizes the mechanism of action, pharmacokinetics, key clinical trials, and clinical efficacy and safety data for fruquintinib.

papers.title_zh: Fruquintinib：作用機轉、臨床與轉譯科學
papers.abstract_zh: Fruquintinib是一種高選擇性口服血管內皮生長因子受體(-1、-2、-3)抑制劑，已於中國、美國及歐盟核准用於治療經治療過之轉移性大腸直腸癌(mCRC)。Fruquintinib在mCRC的療效已於隨機、雙盲第三期臨床試驗中一致證實，包括在中國收案的FRESCO(NCT02314819)，以及在北美、歐洲、亞洲及澳洲14個國家收案的FRESCO-2(NCT04322539)。兩項試驗中，病人皆以2:1比例隨機分配接受口服fruquintinib 5mg或匹配安慰劑，每日一次，28天週期中服用3週停1週，並加上最佳支持性照護，直至疾病惡化或無法耐受之毒性。FRESCO與FRESCO-2皆達成其主要終點，顯示fruquintinib相較安慰劑在整體存活(OS)有顯著改善：FRESCO中(fruquintinib組n=278；安慰劑組n=138)，中位OS為fruquintinib組9.3個月對安慰劑組6.6個月(風險比[HR] 0.65；95%信賴區間[CI] 0.51-0.83；p<0.001)；FRESCO-2中(fruquintinib組n=461；安慰劑組n=230)，中位OS為fruquintinib組7.4個月對安慰劑組4.8個月(HR 0.66；95% CI 0.55-0.80；p<0.001)。使用fruquintinib最常見之任何等級治療相關不良事件(任一試驗中發生率≥20%，不含實驗室異常)包括高血壓、手足症候群、蛋白尿、聲音嘶啞、腹瀉、無力、食慾下降、甲狀腺低下及疲倦。本迷你綜述總結fruquintinib之作用機轉、藥物動力學、關鍵臨床試驗及臨床療效與安全性資料。

cautions: 本文為綜述，非新資料，僅整理已發表FRESCO/FRESCO-2試驗結果，無原始批判性分析
OS僅提供中位數與HR，未給絕對存活率（如1年存活率），無法計算ARR/NNT
適用族群為後線（經治療失敗）mCRC，非早期或可切除病人，外科臨床適用範圍有限
unassessable: 盲法細節（雖稱雙盲但未描述執行方式）
papers.context: 無相關前作。先前看過的ANCHOR試驗為第一線anlotinib對比bevacizumab於RAS/BRAF野生型mCRC，與本篇fruquintinib於後線治療之設定及族群皆不同，無直接關聯。
